originalTitle: Wall Street closes down sharply after Fed holds rates unchanged
summary: STORY: Wall Street ended sharply lower on Wednesday, with the Dow tumbling more than two percent, the S&P 500 shedding one-and-a-half percent and the Nasdaq falling one-and-three-quarters percent. :: Archive The Fed's widely expected decision to leave interest rates unchanged drew dissents from three of the 12 members of the central bank's policy-setting committee, who would have "preferred" a quarter-percentage-point hike at Wednesday's meeting. Eric Diton is president and managing director of The Wealth Alliance. "That's telling you the Fed here is not in agreement. Three dissenters is a lot. And it's clear that we are getting closer and closer to a rate hike. And the markets are handicapping that. So, I think going forward I would expect a rate hike probably in September, certainly by December. I think that’s where we are heading.” Meanwhile, investors continued to worry about Big Tech companies funneling billions of dollars into AI at the expense of free cash flow. Case in point: shares of Meta fell more than 9% in extended trading after the social media company hiked its forecast for 2026 capital expenditure. But shares of another Magnificent 7 tech giant climbed in extending trading. Microsoft rose about 2% after topping Wall Street estimates for quarterly cloud revenue growth, a sign its massive spending on AI infrastructure was paying off. :: Microsoft :: Archive AI-related chipmakers added to recent losses after a sixfold jump in SK Hynix's quarterly profit fell short of lofty investor expectations.

chineseTitle: 美联储维持利率不变后华尔街大幅收跌
chineseSummary: 故事：华尔街周三收盘大幅走低，道琼斯指数下跌逾百分之二，标准普尔 500 指数下跌百分之五，纳斯达克指数下跌四分之三。 :: Archive 美联储普遍预期维持利率不变的决定引起了央行政策制定委员会 12 名成员中的 3 名成员的反对，他们“更倾向于”在周三的会议上加息 25 个百分点。埃里克·迪顿 (Eric Diton) 是财富联盟的总裁兼董事总经理。 “这告诉你，美联储没有达成一致。三个反对者已经很多了。很明显，我们越来越接近加息。而市场正在阻碍这一点。所以，我认为展望未来，我预计可能会在 9 月加息，当然是在 12 月。我认为这就是我们的前进方向。”与此同时，投资者仍然担心大型科技公司以牺牲自由现金流为代价，将数十亿美元投入人工智能领域。典型的例子是：社交媒体公司 Meta 上调 2026 年资本支出预测后，其股价在盘后交易中下跌超过 9%。但另一家科技巨头 Magnificent 7 的股价在延长交易中上涨。微软季度云收入增长超出华尔街预期，股价上涨约 2%，这表明其在人工智能基础设施上的巨额支出正在获得回报。 SK 海力士季度利润增长六倍，低于投资者的高预期，导致人工智能相关芯片制造商近期亏损进一步加剧。
